info.title: Bethany House Hub API
info.description:
The staff and storefront API behind the Hub console and the native apps.

Conventions every client must honour:
- Bearer token from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login` (Sanctum). Send `X-Device-Id` (16–64 chars `[A-Za-z0-9-]`) and, for polling, `X-Background-Request: 1`.
- 401: signed out. 423 `reason: pin_locked`: unlock with `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/pin/unlock` then retry. 403 `code: step_up_required`: confirm identity (`/admin/auth/step-up`) then retry. 403 `code: download_approval_required`: request approval. 429: wait `retry_after_seconds`.
- Money arrives as the server computed it; clients never sum, convert or round. Decimal strings are parsed as decimals, never floats.
- Pagination is Laravel's `{data, current_page, last_page, per_page, total}`.
- Timestamps are Africa/Nairobi wall-clock unless suffixed with a zone.

post.description: Password step. Answers with a session, a 2FA challenge, or a forced 2FA setup token. Locked accounts answer 423.

get.summary: The signed-in person, their effective permissions and session policy

post.summary: Renew the session (sliding, inside the role limits)
post.description: Mints a replacement bearer token for the same session and revokes the current one. The new expiry is the token TTL from now, capped at the role's absolute limit counted from the original sign-in. 409 when the token is a kiosk token or has no expiry.

post.summary: Register a native push token (APNs or FCM)

recovery_code.description: Alternative to code; each works once

token.description: Bearer token; store in the platform keychain

permissions.description: Effective permission slugs; money report pages already removed per FinancialVisibility

token.description: APNs device token (hex) or FCM registration token

model.description: Hardware model, e.g. iPhone15,2 or SM-X916B

MoneyByCurrency.description: A list of rows in several currencies: KES total at each row's own reporting rate, native figures beside it, unconvertible ones named. Never a sum across currencies.

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session: sign in again

Forbidden.description: Not permitted; `code: step_up_required` asks for identity confirmation, `code: download_approval_required` for an approval

Locked.description: `reason: pin_locked` (unlock with the terminal PIN) or `reason: account_locked`
